an1.140:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] ye te bhikkhave bhikkhū adhammaṃ adhammoti dīpenti, te bhikkhave bhikkhū bahujanahitāya paṭipannā bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an1.140:1.2: bahuñca te bhikkhave bhikkhū puññaṃ pasavanti. tevimaṃ saddhammaṃ ṭhapentīti.
